images.filename: Prehistoric Ramparts on Mither Tap - geograph.org.uk - 1083635.jpg
images.caption: Prehistoric Ramparts on Mither Tap. The Mither Tap of Bennachie has an unrivalled view in all directions, and was heavily fortified in prehistoric times. The intrusive white patches are, I regret to say, plastic bags of sand left by the teams who have recently been working on the access footpaths. Compare with 4372.
